guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Check Your ARX Eligibility
guide.description: Go to the Arcium RTG portal or use the Magna portal and open the eligibility checker.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect Your Solana Wallet
guide.description: Connect a Solana wallet such as Phantom, Solflare, or Backpack. Approve the connection so the portal can read your contribution history and any allocation tied to your wallet or Discord identity.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Review Your RTG Allocation
guide.description: Check the allocation shown in the encrypted portal. A zero balance does not always mean exclusion, as your contributions may still be under review or set for a later RTG wave.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim Your ARX Tokens
guide.description: If you have an allocation, confirm the claim transaction in your wallet. Keep a small amount of SOL on hand to cover the Solana network fee. Your ARX will arrive in the connected wallet once the transaction settles.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim Through Binance Alpha
guide.description: Eligible Binance users can claim ARX with Binance Alpha Points on the Alpha Events page once trading is open. Create or log in to Binance , or swap and bridge funds using the widget below, open Alpha Events, and follow the on-screen claim steps for ARX. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Ope
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Keep Earning in Future RTG Waves
guide.description: If you have no allocation yet, submit new contributions through the RTG Directory inside the portal. Work across the Developer, Ecosystem, and Community tracks earns Encrypted Credits that can convert to ARX in a future wave.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
